description: The pie chart visually represents the distribution of question-answer dataset categories used in the study, with four distinct segments labeled TriviaQA, WebQA, HalluEval, and HalluQA, alongside an unlabeled 6% slice. The largest segment, colored red, corresponds to TriviaQA, accounting for 46% (1,829 instances). The purple segment represents WebQA at 25% (997 instances). The green segment, HalluEval, comprises 18% (721 instances), while the small blue slice, HalluQA, makes up 5% (185 instances). An additional unlabeled gray segment, marked as 6% (231 instances), is shown below the main chart, possibly indicating a separate or unclassified category. The chart uses a 3D effect with the TriviaQA slice slightly exploded for emphasis, and each segment includes both percentage and absolute count values. The legend is integrated directly into the chart via labels pointing to each slice.
